description.value: Memory Corner is an authentic Taiwanese restaurant in Richmond, BC, part of the Memory Corner Group founded in 1975 and spanning three brands and a central kitchen. The restaurant specializes in high-heat stir-fries, slow-braised dishes, hot pots, and crispy Taiwanese classics made with seasonal ingredients and traditional technique. The group also operates an in-store Taiwanese convenience store and sells a curated lineup of Taiwanese craft beers for dine-in or online order.
